title: Add a school under a group

steps.say: **Add a school** only appears on a plain group, because a school cannot contain another school. Tapping it opens a name field and creates nothing.
Type the school's name and tap **Add**. It appears in the list below with its own home page, its own staff and its own learners, still rolling up into whatever sits above it.
steps.terminal: That's a school inside a group — its own place, still part of yours. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
